what_it_is: A static scanner: reads MCP configuration files (mcpServers JSON) and MCP server source code before deployment. It does not run servers or capture MCP traffic.

not_run.scan --local: also sweeps this machine's own Claude/Cursor/VS Code/Windsurf/Zed configs; the project scanner was run on the lab configs only
not_run.trust: sends each server's source to the npm and GitHub APIs; the lab's sources are local script paths, which it would query npm for as package names
not_run.analyze: aggregates configs collected from many machines (collectors/); not applicable
